cells.tense: You are holding two growing things steady this minute, and your hand is on the pen.
cells.act: let what you gave up be seen by the people it was for, without a word about it
cells.ask: Pick the thing under your care that you have quietly paid for. Put one hour into it this week while the people it serves are around. Let the cost stay quiet.
cells.core:
Two growing things sit in your care at once, and both stay alive without force. You keep the shape of what each one needs in your head and give it before anyone asks. When a choice comes up between them, you tend both instead of dropping one, and the balance holds because your moves are small and exact. From the outside it looks easy.

What the pattern wouldn't show is the price: hours already spent on the one nobody has watched. Pick the thing under your care that you have quietly paid for, and this week put an hour of work into it while the people it serves are around. Let the cost stay quiet. Being seen doing it is the part that usually goes missing, and that hour is the whole of it.

cells.tense: You are about to keep something alive that has not yet had any chance to fail.
cells.act: walk through the thing you built and touch nothing
cells.ask: Take the finished thing you keep reaching past, and use it as it stands. Touch nothing, fix nothing, plan nothing. Let it be done for as long as you can stand it.
cells.core:
You are tending things ahead of their own timing, keeping each one safe before it has any risk in it. Most people set down what is finished and move on. You are back there bracing it, holding it inside a version you can predict, because the next moment hasn't been written yet and that is hard to sit inside. What was growing has stopped and become something that only might.

The way out runs backward, not forward. Take the finished thing you keep reaching past and use it, exactly as it stands, for as long as you can stand it. No fixing, no plan for what it could be. Walk through what you already built and touch nothing. Leaving the kitchen as it is, once, is the practice.

cells.tense: You tended it well and then set the whole thing down, and you have picked up nothing since.
cells.act: go on toward it without needing a sign
cells.ask: Write where you want to get to, one line, no plan. Then take one step toward it on the day you least feel like it, without waiting for a sign.
cells.core:
You stand at a door that is already behind you, and you are not walking through another. The care itself is fine; you know how to do that part. What's missing is direction — you kept the thing growing and stopped naming what it's growing toward. From outside, the care still looks steady. Inside, it's upkeep: no wish, no sign, no reason the next push matters.

What comes back around isn't effort. That seat is running on empty, and strain poured into it only tightens the jaw. So the move is small and it lands on the wish. Write where you want to get to, one clean line, no plan attached. Then take one step toward it on the day you least feel like it, without waiting for a sign to come first.

cells.tense: You are deciding what the thing needs right now, and the deciding carries no one's name.
cells.act: make the sacrifice visible without explaining it
cells.ask: Next time you carry the piece nobody asked you to carry, do it where the ones it serves can watch. Explain nothing after; let it be seen as you do it.
cells.core:
The pattern here is yours. You have been steering where a thing goes — seeing what it needs and making sure it arrives — and if someone asked, you would say you just ended up there. The decisions get made; the author of them goes unnamed; you file them under the shape of the situation. It stays unexamined because it is rarely said out loud.

Acknowledgment begins with standing where the doing can be seen. Next time you carry the piece nobody asked you to carry, do it where the ones it serves can watch. Explain nothing afterward. Nothing has to be declared; the act does the work. Being visible while you do it is what returns your name to the work.
